node.title: PROVED (roadmap-lane, toy-verified): the char-0 giant coset theorem
node.statement: Over characteristic zero: every 0/1 t-null vector on mu_n (n = 2^s) is a union of mu_M-cosets with M > t. ONE-PARAGRAPH PROOF (Fourier/Galois): the exponent polynomial f_B has INTEGER coefficients, so f_B(zeta^r) = 0 propagates to the full Galois orbit of zeta^r — all frequencies of the same 2-adic valuation; r in [1, t] realizes every valuation v <= log2(t), so B-hat vanishes at ALL r not divisible by 2^{v+1}-max = the first 2-power > t; hence B-hat is supported on MZ (M = 2^{ceil log2 t}+... the least 2-power > t) and the 0/1 indicator equals its fiber average => a coset union. Verified exhaustively at (n, t) = (16, 4): exactly the mu_8-cosets and their union. NOTE: even easier than X24 (0/1 giant beats signed small-h); the X-8 boundary blocks are FINITE-FIELD-ONLY objects, consistent (see b2's Frobenius gap). STANDALONE PACKET SHIPPED (9/9): full proof written; verifier uses exact cyclotomic arithmetic — full 2^16 brute at (16,4) plus exact rational-nullspace proofs of both directions at (16,4)/(32,4)/(32,8) (nullity = n/M, counts = 2^{n/M}).
